shots.narration: Every film on this line starts the same way. A cold open, a hook in the first ten seconds, and a world that feels real.
He turns the chair before he stands. The door opens fully before he walks through it. Cause, then effect, every time.

shots.narration: Maps are drawn from real borders. India always shows its official boundary, with all of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.
One hundred and eighty people were on board. Every number on screen is checked against a source.
